name: avoid_unnecessary_new_system
prompt: A team wants to add a new queue service because one endpoint is slow. Before implementation, determine what should be investigated.
expected_decisions: measure the current bottleneck before adding infrastructure
compare simpler fixes before introducing operational complexity
red_flags: immediately design a new distributed system
